name: Artemis Technologies
verdict: Maritime technology company controlled by founder Iain Percy and Torbjörn Törnqvist, both private owners. Nothing found.
note: Official Partner of Artemis SailGP (sailgp.com team page, 2026). Companies House lists Iain Percy (>25-50% of shares) and Torbjörn Törnqvist (significant influence or control) as persons with significant control. No state or fund anywhere in the chain, so neither owner passes the record test; nothing found.
